title: (No AI) The fossil fuel comeback is here
author: Justine Calma
content:
![Photo illustration of industrial smokestacks.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25824781/STK438_CLIMATE_CHANGE_C.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

The US is building more fossil fuel infrastructure than it has in a decade while renewable energy growth slows down, a new [report](https://www.edf.org/media/report-us-power-pipeline-shifts-toward-more-costly-polluting-fossil-fuels-clean-energy-faces) shows.

Electricity demand is also climbing faster than it has in [more than a decade](https://www.eia.gov/todayinenergy/detail.php?id=65264) with more data centers, factories, and electric vehicles plugging into the grid. Despite those growing demands, the Trump administration has [sought to hobble](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/10/business/energy-environment/donald-trump-solar-energy-batteries.html) the wind and solar industries in favor of fossil fuels.

title: (No AI) CoreWeave’s debt is becoming the whole AI industry’s problem
author: Elizabeth Lopatto
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/10/Vrg_Illo_AI_Bubble.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

CoreWeave had a bad week last week. Its bonds slipped into [distressed territory](https://www.ft.com/content/8171ef4a-b291-4375-bc85-87bee0f8bf7b) by a common definition - when investors demand 1,000 basis points more in yield than they'd get from government bonds. Last Tuesady Chamath ["SPAC King"](https://www.axios.com/2026/06/24/chamath-palihapitiya-spac-axios-show) Palihapitiya [noticed the distressed debt](https://x.com/chamath/status/2110128893680378299), and also [asked whether the AI buildout was a private credit bubble](https://x.com/chamath/status/2110090896960356768). Its shares are down more than 20 percent since Tuesday's close, which is kind of a lot! There even seemed to be some collateral damage in the market on other AI companies, too.

Now, I have _also_ asked if the AI industry is a bubble, but when the SPAC King echoes concerns held by a lady whose ongoing questi …
